## Status: draft scaffold, no results

No real census, paired comparison, absence check or triage has been run. The code was tested on
synthetic fixtures only. This chapter loads every results table and figure from a file in the
results directory. When a file is missing, the section shows `NOT YET RUN: <file>` instead of a
table. No count, copy number or finding in this chapter comes from data, except the numbers
labelled MEASURED in the text, each with its source.

Labels: MEASURED = read from a database or file on 2026-11-20. PROPOSED = a builder's choice
with no data behind it. UNVERIFIED = not checked.
:::

```{r setup}
# Results directory. Default is ../results (relative to this file).
# Override with the environment variable PC_RESULTS_DIR (the render test points it to an empty directory).
res_dir  <- Sys.getenv("PC_RESULTS_DIR", unset = "../results")
pw_dir   <- Sys.getenv("PC_PATHWAY_DIR", unset = "..")   # holds pathways/ and refs/
pw_id    <- "carotenoid"

placeholder <- function(file) {
  cat(sprintf('\n<div class="not-yet-run"><p><strong>NOT YET RUN: %s</strong></p></div>\n\n', file))
}

# Outputs written with a PROVISIONAL tag are not results. A canonical file name is required, and
# its leading '#' lines must not contain PROVISIONAL. If only a PROVISIONAL file exists, or the
# canonical file has a PROVISIONAL header line, say so and do not load it.
# A name may also exist as <name>.zst (bin/triage.py and paired_compare.py can write zstd files).
find_file <- function(name) {
  for (cand in c(name, paste0(name, ".zst"))) {
    p <- file.path(res_dir, cand)
    if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  }
  NULL
}

# Leading '#' lines of a file (plain or .zst). Reads at most 50 lines.
leading_hash_lines <- function(path) {
  con <- if (grepl("\\.zst$", path)) pipe(paste("zstd -dc", shQuote(path))) else file(path)
  lines <- tryCatch(readLines(con, n = 50, warn = FALSE), finally = close(con))
  n <- 0
  while (n < length(lines) && startsWith(lines[n + 1], "#")) n <- n + 1
  lines[seq_len(n)]
}

read_result <- function(name) {
  path <- find_file(name)
  if (!is.null(path) && any(grepl("PROVISIONAL", leading_hash_lines(path), fixed = TRUE))) {
    # A canonical name is not enough: a PROVISIONAL header line means the file is not a result.
    cat(sprintf('\n<div class="not-yet-run"><p><strong>NOT YET RUN: %s</strong> (the file has a PROVISIONAL header line; provisional outputs are not shown as results)</p></div>\n\n', name))
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (!is.null(path)) {
    # Outputs carry a '# params:' first line (and maybe a PROVISIONAL line): skip '#' lines.
    # Risk: comment.char = "#" also cuts any data field that contains '#'. UNVERIFIED that no
    # real field (for example a species name) contains '#'. Check this when real files exist.
    src <- if (grepl("\\.zst$", path)) pipe(paste("zstd -dc", shQuote(path))) else path
    return(read.delim(src, comment.char = "#", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE))
  }
  prov <- sub("(\\.[^.]+)$", ".PROVISIONAL\\1", name)
  if (!is.null(find_file(prov))) {
    cat(sprintf('\n<div class="not-yet-run"><p><strong>NOT YET RUN: %s</strong> (only a PROVISIONAL file %s exists; provisional outputs are not shown as results)</p></div>\n\n', name, prov))
  } else {
    placeholder(name)
  }
  NULL
}

show_table <- function(df, caption) {
  print(knitr::kable(df, format = "html", caption = caption, row.names = FALSE,
                     table.attr = 'class="table table-sm"'))
}
```

## Aim and scope {#sec-aim}

This chapter reports a census of carotenoid biosynthesis genes across the BFD fungal genomes. It
is the pilot for a shared pathway-census pipeline (`analysis/pathway_census/`). The design is in
`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-pathway-census-design.md`.

BFD scope (MEASURED, `analysis/pathway_census/README.md`, genome table run 2026-11-20, Task 2
report): 24,363 genomes in `species.parquet`. Of these, 23,379 have a BFD protein file
(`has_proteins` True) and 984 do not. Genomes per `prior_status` in BFD (MEASURED, same source):
`baseline_ok` 5,625; `no_prior_annotation_present` 18,055; `no_prior_annotation_not_downloaded` 673;
`annotated_folder_missing_protein` 10. The prior-annotation TSV has 27,401 rows (MEASURED, same
source). The counts in spec section 3 are TSV-wide, so they differ from these BFD-scoped counts.

## Data files this chapter reads {#sec-data}

All files are read from the results directory (`../results`, or `PC_RESULTS_DIR`). A name may also
exist with a `.zst` suffix. A file with a `.PROVISIONAL` name, or with a `PROVISIONAL` line among its
leading `#` lines, is never shown as a result.

- `carotenoid_phylum_summary.tsv`: written by `bin/build_matrix.py` (name set by the CLI).
- `carotenoid_paired_summary.tsv`, `carotenoid_paired_dropped_providers.tsv`,
  `carotenoid_paired_by_busco.tsv`, `carotenoid_paired_unpaired.json`: written by
  `bin/paired_compare.py` (names set by the CLI).
- `carotenoid_triage.tsv`: written by `bin/triage.py` (name set by the caller through `--out`; the
  name is PROPOSED here).
- `carotenoid_absence_summary.tsv`: the merged chunk files of `bin/absence_check.py`, written by
  `bin/merge_absence.py --out results/carotenoid_absence_summary.tsv <chunks>`. The name is PROPOSED.
  The script refuses mixed provisional and non-provisional chunks and tags a provisional merge.

Reading notes. TSV outputs start with `# ` lines (`# params:`, sometimes `# PROVISIONAL`). The
reader skips them with `comment.char = "#"`. That setting also truncates any field that contains
`#` (UNVERIFIED that none does).

## Pathway steps and reference provenance {#sec-pathway}

The step list comes from `pathways/carotenoid.yaml`. The reference provenance comes from
`refs/carotenoid/provenance.tsv`. The pathway is `verified: false` until the user reviews it.

```{r pathway-steps, results='asis'}
ypath <- file.path(pw_dir, "pathways", paste0(pw_id, ".yaml"))
if (file.exists(ypath)) {
  y <- yaml::read_yaml(ypath)
  cat(sprintf("Pathway `%s`, pathway-level verified: **%s**.\n\n", y$id, tolower(as.character(y$verified))))
  steps <- do.call(rbind, lapply(y$steps, function(s) {
    refs <- s$refs
    nver <- sum(vapply(refs, function(r) isTRUE(r$verified), logical(1)))
    data.frame(step = s$id, name = s$name, EC = if (is.null(s$ec)) "" else s$ec,
               role = if (is.null(s$role)) "" else s$role,
               copy_expect_PROPOSED = if (is.null(s$copy_expect)) "" else s$copy_expect,
               domains_any = paste(unlist(s$domains_any), collapse = ", "),
               n_refs = length(refs), n_refs_verified = nver, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  div_open <- '<div id="pathway-definition">'
  cat(div_open, "\n")
  show_table(steps, "Pathway steps (from pathways/carotenoid.yaml)")
  cat("</div>\n\n")
} else {
  placeholder(file.path("pathways", paste0(pw_id, ".yaml")))
}
```

```{r provenance, results='asis'}
ppath <- file.path(pw_dir, "refs", pw_id, "provenance.tsv")
if (file.exists(ppath)) {
  pv <- read.delim(ppath, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character")
  cat(sprintf("Reference provenance rows: %d. Verified: %d. Unverified: %d.\n\n",
              nrow(pv), sum(pv$verified == "true"), sum(pv$verified != "true")))
  cat('<div id="reference-provenance">\n')
  show_table(pv, "Reference provenance (from refs/carotenoid/provenance.tsv)")
  cat("</div>\n\n")
} else {
  placeholder(file.path("refs", pw_id, "provenance.tsv"))
}
```

MEASURED (Task 3; `refs/carotenoid/UNVERIFIED.md` and the reference curation record in
`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-20-pilot-lessons.md`): 23 curated references,
22 verified against UniProt and PubMed on 2026-11-20, 1 unverified (PMID 16416328, Ojima 2006, no
protein accession). The pathway stays `verified: false`.

## Phylum by step copy number {#sec-phylum}

Source: `results/carotenoid_phylum_summary.tsv` (from `bin/build_matrix.py`). The summary uses
`copy_filtered` by default. The contamination flag is NA (unknown) for every copy until the
contamination table exists. `contam_suspect` is a default required flag, so every copy then lands in
`copy_unknown`, and `copy_filtered` is 0 everywhere (final review, reviewer MEASURED on a synthetic
case: `copy_raw` 1, `copy_filtered` 0, `frac_with_step` 0.0). Read `n_unknown` and
`copy_unknown_total` with every count. The raw and filtered copy totals are shown side by side below.
Raw per-phylum fractions are not corrected for uneven sampling across lineages (spec section 2
anti-goal "Phylogeny read as biology").

```{r phylum, results='asis'}
f <- "carotenoid_phylum_summary.tsv"
d <- read_result(f)
if (!is.null(d)) {
  show_table(d, "Copy number per phylum and step")
  if (all(c("phylum", "step_id", "copy_raw_total", "copy_filtered_total") %in% names(d))) {
    cat("Note: filtered = 0 until the contamination table exists (every copy is then `copy_unknown`).\n\n")
    for (col in c("copy_raw_total", "copy_filtered_total")) {
      w <- tapply(d[[col]], list(d$phylum, d$step_id), function(x) x[1])
      w <- data.frame(phylum = rownames(w), as.data.frame.matrix(w), check.names = FALSE)
      cat(sprintf('\n<div id="%s">\n', if (col == "copy_raw_total") "phylum-raw" else "phylum-filtered"))
      show_table(w, sprintf("%s per phylum (rows) and step (columns)", col))
      cat("</div>\n\n")
    }
  }
  if (all(c("phylum", "step_id", "frac_with_step") %in% names(d))) {
    m <- tapply(d$frac_with_step, list(d$phylum, d$step_id), function(x) x[1])
    cat('\n<div id="phylum-figure">\n')
    op <- par(mar = c(8, 12, 2, 2))
    plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "",
         main = "Fraction of genomes with the step (grey cell = NA: no genomes or no row)")
    usr <- par("usr"); rect(usr[1], usr[3], usr[2], usr[4], col = "grey80", border = NA)
    image(t(m[nrow(m):1, , drop = FALSE]), axes = FALSE, add = TRUE, zlim = c(0, 1),
          col = hcl.colors(20, "Blues 3", rev = TRUE))
    axis(1, at = seq(0, 1, length.out = ncol(m)), labels = colnames(m), las = 2, cex.axis = 0.7)
    axis(2, at = seq(0, 1, length.out = nrow(m)), labels = rev(rownames(m)), las = 1, cex.axis = 0.7)
    par(op)
    cat("</div>\n\n")
  }
}
```

## Paired deposited versus BFD comparison {#sec-paired}

Sources: `results/carotenoid_paired_summary.tsv`, `results/carotenoid_paired_dropped_providers.tsv`,
`results/carotenoid_paired_by_busco.tsv`, `results/carotenoid_paired_unpaired.json`. Each TSV has a
`# params:` first line that is skipped on reading.

What the test shows: for assemblies with both a deposited annotation and a BFD annotation, the
difference in copies per step. The assembly is the same in both arms, so the difference is the
effect of the annotation. What it does not show: anything about the genomes with no prior
annotation (BFD: 18,055 `no_prior_annotation_present` and 673 `no_prior_annotation_not_downloaded`,
MEASURED, Task 2 report; spec section 5.6), which annotation is correct, or absence of a gene. A difference is a
finding only if it has the same sign across annotation providers and survives the BUSCO control.
Otherwise report it as not established.

The deposited-arm pipeline is not built (see Limitations).

```{r paired, results='asis'}
for (f in c("carotenoid_paired_summary.tsv", "carotenoid_paired_dropped_providers.tsv",
            "carotenoid_paired_by_busco.tsv")) {
  d <- read_result(f)
  if (!is.null(d)) show_table(d, f)
}
f <- "carotenoid_paired_unpaired.json"
if (file.exists(file.path(res_dir, f))) {
  j <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(res_dir, f))
  cat("\n```\n", jsonlite::toJSON(j, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  placeholder(f)
}
```

## Absence check {#sec-absence}

Source: `results/carotenoid_absence_summary.tsv`. This file is the merged chunk output of
`bin/absence_check.py` (`carotenoid_absence.chunk<ID>.tsv`), merged by `bin/merge_absence.py`. The
name is PROPOSED. Expected columns:
`locustag, step_id, outcome, reason`. Outcomes: `present_unannotated`, `fragmented`, `absent`,
`unconfirmed`. `unconfirmed` means no BFD FASTA, not proven absence.

```{r absence, results='asis'}
f <- "carotenoid_absence_summary.tsv"
d <- read_result(f)
if (!is.null(d)) {
  if ("outcome" %in% names(d)) {
    tb <- as.data.frame(table(step_id = d$step_id, outcome = d$outcome), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    names(tb)[3] <- "n"
    show_table(tb, "Absence-check outcome counts per step")
  } else {
    show_table(head(d, 50), "First 50 rows (no outcome column found)")
  }
}
```

## Triage list {#sec-triage}

Source: `results/carotenoid_triage.tsv` (from `bin/triage.py`). The bins are triage. They are not a
ranking and not an activity prediction (spec section 5.5). All thresholds are PROPOSED.

```{r triage, results='asis'}
f <- "carotenoid_triage.tsv"
d <- read_result(f)
if (!is.null(d)) {
  if ("bin" %in% names(d)) {
    tb <- as.data.frame(table(step_id = d$step_id, bin = d$bin), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    names(tb)[3] <- "n"
    show_table(tb, "Triage bin counts per step")
  }
  show_table(head(d, 100), "First 100 triage rows")
}
```

## Limitations {#sec-limitations}

1. **The pathway definition is not reviewed.** `pathways/carotenoid.yaml` has `verified: false`
   until the user reviews the step list (spec section 5.8). Every output from an unverified pathway
   carries a `PROVISIONAL` tag.
2. **One reference is unverified.** PMID 16416328 (Ojima 2006, astaxanthin synthase of
   *Xanthophyllomyces dendrorhous*) has no protein accession. 22 of 23 references are verified.
3. **Contamination and haplotype flags are NA.** BFD has no per-gene taxonomy table. The
   contamination flag needs a best-hit table (fungal versus non-fungal reference set) that is not
   built. The haplotype flag needs a pair-identity table that is not built. Until then these flags
   are NA (unknown). With the default `require` (truncated, contam_suspect), every copy is then
   `copy_unknown` and `copy_filtered` is 0 everywhere. Use `copy_raw` with `copy_unknown` until the
   contamination table exists. NA is not treated as clean.
4. **The deposited-arm pipeline is not built.** The paired test needs a copy matrix from the
   deposited proteins. Deposited protein IDs do not start with the BFD LOCUSTAG prefix, so a prefix rewrite or a
   `genome_of` mapping is needed first.
5. **What the paired test does and does not show.** It compares annotations on the same assemblies.
   It does not cover the genomes without a prior annotation (18,055 plus 673 in BFD, MEASURED, Task 2
   report), does not show which annotation
   is correct, and does not show absence of a gene (spec section 5.6).
6. **Thresholds are PROPOSED.** Examples: `min_score` rule, dereplication at 90% identity above
   50,000 proteins, fusion overlap 50%, `min_bitscore` 50, `min_query_cover` 0.7, `min_pairs` 20,
   triage tier minimums, `window_bp` 20,000. None has a measured basis.
7. **Real-data runs are deferred.** The census, paired comparison, absence check and triage ran on
   synthetic fixtures only. No placement tool is wired up, so step assignment has no real input.
8. **No per-gene taxonomy in BFD** (see item 3). The SwissProt tables may support a fungal call
   with a taxid-to-lineage map. This is UNVERIFIED and was not used.
9. **`downloaded` False is not proven absence.** It means no BFD genome FASTA. A copy may exist
   elsewhere. The absence check reports these as `unconfirmed`.

## Reproducibility {#sec-repro}

Render: `module load quarto/1.7.31` then
`quarto render analysis/pathway_census/chapters/A_carotenoid.qmd`. Engine: knitr with R, because
the Python 3.12 interpreter has no jupyter. R packages used: `knitr`, `rmarkdown`, `yaml` and
`jsonlite` (all present on 2026-11-20: knitr 1.50, rmarkdown 2.30; `yaml` and `jsonlite` loaded
without error, versions not recorded). `zstd` must be on PATH to read `.zst` files. The pilot lessons are in
`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-20-pilot-lessons.md`.
